verdict.rationale: Fern ships a built-in Fern Agent that reads the docs site's source repository and makes the changes you describe, for example moving SDK guides and fixing links. It can also be kicked off from Slack, or scheduled as automations that review feedback and analytics, report findings and open pull requests. That clearly covers delegating real tasks to an in-product AI assistant. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Fern Agent's reliability, and detailed docs on its in-product interface, scope limits and review/approval flow.
